_comment: Reference values for qe-input-relax (QE 7.4 conda-forge build hac89879_0). The deliverable is an input deck, so refs pin the semantic thresholds, the zinc-blende SiC reference structure, and the pseudopotential hashes; the L4-lite truncated single point is the execution check (no energy reference needed — ecutwfc/k-grid are agent-chosen above the stated minima). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: L4-lite truncated scf of the oracle deck (ecutwfc=50/ecutrho=400, 4x4x4 shifted grid, conv_thr 1e-8) runs in ~6 s and converges in 18 iterations (E=-29.89286497 Ry, not used as a gate). Verified deterministic across the probe run and 3/3 CI oracle runs. The verifier executes the agent's own deck (truncated to scf), so runtime scales with the agent's cutoff/grid choices; timeout budget 240 s is ~40x the oracle's.
